'''Omarlin Fisker'''<ref name="Disney Infinity">''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]''</ref> was a fair-skinned [[human]].<ref name="TFA" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VII}} to [[34 ABY]].</ref> they were among a group who gathered in the courtyard of<ref name="TFA" /> the [[pirate]]<ref name="TFAVD">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Maz Kanata]]'s [[Takodana Castle|castle]] on the [[planet]] [[Takodana]] in order to watch the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]] of the [[Hosnian system]] by the [[First Order]]'s [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]]. The First Order then [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] the castle and destroyed it. While on Takodana they wore a [[Color|red]] and brown [[hat]] with a matching [[Clothing|coat]] over a gray shirt.<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Omarlin Fisker was portrayed by an extra in the [[2015]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. She was not identified in the film,<ref name="TFA" /> but received a name when she appeared as an unlockable character in the "The Force Awakens" expansion for the video game ''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]'',<ref name="Disney Infinity" /> which was released on the same day as the film.<ref name="Infinity Release">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-force-awakens-play-set-for-disney-infinity-3-0-edition-now-available|text=''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Play Set for ''Disney Infinity 3.0 Edition'' Now Available}}</ref> Despite the game's non-[[canon]] status, [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Pablo Hidalgo]] has stated on [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] that names used in the game are considered canon.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/749616406245699584|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2016-07-03|quote=@LelalMekha Yeah, same with Infinity.|archivefile=File:PabloHidalgo-LegoName-Twitter.png|nolive=1}} {{C|In response to: "@pablohidalgo <nowiki>youtube.com/watch?v=JwxAeHPLpPg</nowiki> The Lego game identifies a few BG characters from TFA, but are those names canonical?"}} — [[Pablo Hidalgo]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] has confirmed that the character names introduced in ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'' and ''[[Disney Infinity 3.0]]'' are considered [[canon]], despite the [[Star Wars video games|video game]]s themselves being non-canon.</ref>
